verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents separate vector indexes (distance-based ranking) and BM25 text indexes, and describes a unified operation-tree model that 'combines a property graph, approximate vector search, and BM25 full-text search' in one query engine, implying they can be used together. However, there is no explicit documentation of a fusion-ranking mechanism (e.g., weighted score combination or reciprocal rank fusion) that merges BM25 and vector scores into a single ranked result set within one query. Missing for 10: explicit fusion-ranking algorithm/API, a worked example combining BM25 and vector scores in one query, and independent confirmation of hybrid ranking quality.
